title: Battle of Punta Malpelo
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Battle of Punta Malpelo", at revision 1370586793, opens: "The Battle of Punta Malpelo was a naval encounter between a Peruvian corvette and two Gran Colombian vessels on 31 August 1828, near the port of Guayaquil, and was the first major combat of the Peruvian Navy as an independent force of the newborn Peruvian nation." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q2984826, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1828 Gran Columbia-Peru War naval battle". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
